reply: For assessing API concentration in a powder blend within the feed frame, NIR (diffuse reflection) and Raman spectroscopy are promising methods. NIR is suitable for online applications due to its penetration depth and compatibility with fiber optics. Raman can provide complementary information, especially for symmetric vibrations. A pilot should test each method individually before considering a combined approach.
